work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. LXXXVII heading/synopsis 102098–102105 and explicit protocol 102107–102108 establish the Joachim act. The preamble and §§1–4 proceed coherently through institution, execution, derogation and transumpts, ending at the own dating clause 102193–102195 and printed date 102197. The historical note 102118–102124 compares the Anne act and Gregory XIII’s earlier provision and belongs to this synopsis; retain it without promoting its earlier papal references to top-level acts. LXXXVIII starts 102200 with a new protocol 102214. No mixed or reversed body columns were found.
